name: accrete
northStar: Agents on Durable Objects build the tools they need once, so container-seconds per task fall toward zero as the registry grows.
constraint: A built tool must run in a Worker isolate with no network and no secrets, and must match the native tool's output before it is registered.
falsifiable: After a tool is in the registry, a repeat of the same task uses 0 container-seconds. Disproved if any repeat run uses the container.

proven.claim: A repeat run with the same tools uses 0 container-seconds.
proven.observed: Run 3: 6/6 tasks, 0 container calls, 0 container-seconds, 3 tools from the registry.

proven.claim: A missing npm tool is built once in a container, checked against native output, then reused.
proven.observed: Run 1 built json5 cold in the container. Runs 2 and 3 used the registry copy.

proven.claim: A built tool whose output differs from the native tool is rejected.
proven.observed: Recipe json5-bad got HTTP 500 and was not listed.

proven.claim: tsc from the registry type-checks accrete's own src/ in an isolate.
proven.observed: 8 files, clean, placement built-tool, 0 container-seconds, 811 ms.

proven.claim: Repeat runs use 0 container-seconds across the whole bench, not just the demo.
proven.observed: 10 tools, train 4/4, held-out 6/7. Repeat container-seconds per task: 0.00.
Repeat uses no container. Tampered bundle refused. Network tool fails. Bad recipe rejected.

unproven.claim: Total container cost falls toward zero over a long run.
unproven.why: Bench is 11 tools. No long mixed-task run yet.

unproven.claim: The Worker log measures builder cost correctly.
unproven.why: GraphQL billed about 62 s of uptime where the Worker logged 6.4 s. Cold start is the likely cause, not confirmed.

disproven.claim: GraphQL containerUptime or allocatedCpu measures each build.
disproven.observed: A json5 build with 7.3 s in the Worker log showed 0 uptime and 0 allocated vCPU in GraphQL for that minute.

disproven.claim: Any npm tool can be bundled for an isolate.
disproven.observed: TypeScript 7 ships a native binary. The tsc tool uses TypeScript 5.9.3.

disproven.claim: Every held-out tool builds without code generation.
disproven.observed: prettier loads its CLI through new Function. It fails in the isolate.

openQuestions: What is the real cost of one cold build, including container start and stop?
Which tool kinds other than esm (wasi, container-only) are worth the next experiment?
Does the registry need a time limit or a size limit?
